name: settings.job

stopping_wait_time.description: The graceful shutdown period for an Azure Webjob. The time specified in seconds.

is_singleton.description: Specify if the Webjob should be treated as a singleton. If true, the Webjob will not scale on multiple Azure Website instances like the web application itself.

schema.title: JSON schema for Azure Webjob settings.job files

description: The current Azure WebJob configuration specifies a graceful shutdown period of 45 seconds, meaning the job will be allowed to finish any in‑flight work for up to 45 seconds before it is terminated. Additionally, the job is not configured as a singleton; it may run on multiple instances of the Azure Web App and will scale out alongside the web application rather than being restricted to a single instance.
